title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Theater on 1972-07-25
lineage: SBD> MR> C> D> CD> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard recording with minor dropouts highlights a unique, smoking The Other One jam that lifts an otherwise mellow summer‑'72 show.
ai_review.review: The board source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though a few early mix hiccups and brief drop‑outs are noted. Musically the second set shines – especially an unprecedented, exploratory jam in The Other One – while the first set remains pleasant but unremarkable. Overall reviewers praise the show’s historic moment despite its modest energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating across 12 detailed reviews is 4.25; comments are consistently positive about the standout Other One jam and generally good soundboard quality, giving a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp board mix with room ambience; occasional early‑song balance issues (Promised Land, Sugaree) and minor dropouts/cuts, but overall clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is pleasant but subdued; second set builds momentum and delivers a unique, exploratory jam in The Other One that becomes the show’s highlight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Wiry playing early, later slides with Allman‑like lines; described as 'fighting for his life' and occasionally out of tune.
band_member_comments.Phil: Gnarly bass solo in The Other One; contrapuntal lines praised as stately and powerful.
band_member_comments.Bob: Prominent vocal/guitar on Promised Land and Sugaree (right‑ear dominance); overall strong rhythm work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s mix is low early but later adds substantive texture; occasional out‑of‑time moments noted.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann's drums sit higher in the mix than usual, providing solid drive throughout.
